messages.author: 3b242040e3845b6c
messages.subject: geom_boxplot ordering within group
parts:
I have a situation where I assign a colour and a fill based on various
variable in my dataset i.e.

ggplot(plotdata,aes(x=Name,y=log2value)) +
geom_boxplot(aes(colour=Probe,fill=Sample))

The problem I am having is that it is ordering the boxplots within a
Name group according to fill variable "Sample" instead of the colour
variable "Probe". The reason I want to do this is that for each Name
there are red probes and green probes and two out of three sample
types. Is there anyway to do this?

Thanks

parts:
Sorry Luciano, I sent the image before I read Ben Bolker's reply,
which I have only just read. So give me a break please. Here is a
reproducible example:

library(ggplot2)
a <-
data.frame(Name="1",Probe="R",Sample="sampleone",value=rnorm(10,0,1))
b <-
data.frame(Name="1",Probe="G",Sample="sampletwo",value=rnorm(10,1,1))
c <-
data.frame(Name="2",Probe="R",Sample="sampletwo",value=rnorm(10,2,2))
d <-
data.frame(Name="2",Probe="G",Sample="samplethree",value=rnorm(10,1,1))
plotdata <- rbind(a,b,c,d)

ggplot(plotdata,aes(x=Name,y=value)) +
geom_boxplot(aes(colour=Probe,fill=Sample))
+ scale_colour_manual(values = c("green","red")) +
scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set3")

My problem can be solved by using interaction:

ggplot(plotdata,aes(x=Name,y=value,
group=interaction(Name,Sample,Probe)))
+ geom_boxplot(aes(colour=Probe,fill=Sample)) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("green","red")) +
scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set3")

How did you find out about group and interaction. I cannot find any
mention of interaction in the ggplot2 book.

Thanks
